description: Database patterns and pitfalls for Drizzle ORM with SQLite/libSQL

patterns.title: Drizzle config relative path for DATABASE_URL
patterns.problem: drizzle.config.ts runs from packages/db/, but DATABASE_URL is relative to project root or apps/server
patterns.solution: Use file: prefix with absolute path in .env, or configure dotenv to load from correct location

patterns.title: Turso dialect for local SQLite with cloud option
patterns.problem: Need local SQLite development with option for Turso cloud in production
patterns.solution: Use dialect: 'turso' which supports both local file: URLs and Turso cloud connections

patterns.title: Schema tests without database connection
patterns.problem: Testing database package exports requires DATABASE_URL which isn't available in CI/test env
patterns.solution: Test schema exports and column definitions only - avoid importing db client in unit tests

patterns.title: JSON column with text mode for flexible settings
patterns.problem: Need to store flexible key-value settings in SQLite without strict schema
patterns.solution: Use text column with mode: 'json' and $type<> for TypeScript inference
patterns.context7Query: drizzle sqlite json column text mode

patterns.title: Follow existing schema file patterns exactly
patterns.problem: New schema files can diverge from project conventions causing inconsistencies
patterns.solution: Copy import style, timestamp patterns, index naming from existing schema files (e.g., auth.ts)

patterns.title: Complex JSON column typing with nested objects
patterns.problem: Storing nested JSON objects (arrays of objects, nested properties) requires proper TypeScript typing
patterns.solution: Use $type<> with full interface definition for complex JSON structures

patterns.title: Index strategy for state machine columns
patterns.problem: Tables with status columns are frequently filtered by status (state machine queries)
patterns.solution: Create indexes on status columns and any other columns used for grouping/filtering

patterns.title: Set null FK for preserving data on parent deletion
patterns.problem: Default cascade delete removes child records when parent is deleted, but sometimes child records have independent value
patterns.solution: Use onDelete: 'set null' when child records should be preserved as orphans (e.g., learnings are valuable even if source feature is deleted)

patterns.title: Drizzle repository pattern with typed CRUD
patterns.problem: Need a reusable, type-safe repository layer for database entities
patterns.solution: Use $inferSelect/$inferInsert for type derivation, Omit<> for create/update constraints, undefined narrowing for .returning() results

patterns.title: Drizzle transaction type extraction
patterns.problem: Need to pass transaction object to repository methods but Drizzle doesn't export a simple Transaction type
patterns.solution: Use nested Parameters<> utility type to extract the transaction type from db.transaction

patterns.title: Undefined narrowing for .returning() results
patterns.problem: .returning() returns an array where rows[0] can be undefined, but TypeScript doesn't narrow this automatically
patterns.solution: Extract rows[0] into a variable, check for undefined, throw descriptive error

patterns.title: Query by foreign key for entity filtering
patterns.problem: Need to filter entities by foreign key (e.g., features by project, features by status)
patterns.solution: Use eq() with the foreign key column. Dedicate a named method per query for API clarity.

patterns.title: Bulk operations with inArray + returning
patterns.problem: Need to update multiple rows by ID in a single query and return the updated rows
patterns.solution: Use inArray() from drizzle-orm with .returning() for bulk updates. Guard with empty array check.

patterns.title: JSON column dependency resolution with two queries
patterns.problem: A feature stores dependency IDs in a JSON text column. Need to resolve those IDs to full entity records.
patterns.solution: Two-step query: 1) Fetch parent to read JSON column, 2) Use inArray() on the parsed IDs to batch-fetch dependencies.

patterns.title: SQL text append with null safety using CASE WHEN
patterns.problem: Need to append text to a potentially NULL column in a database with newline separation, handling the first append differently
patterns.solution: Use SQL CASE WHEN to check if column IS NULL. If null, set directly to new_text. If not null, concatenate with || and char(10) for newline.
patterns.context7Query: drizzle sqlite null-safe text concatenation sql template

pitfalls.title: drizzle-kit migrate fails with relative path
pitfalls.error: ConnectionFailed("Unable to open connection to local database .nomos/nomos.db: 14")
pitfalls.cause: Relative DATABASE_URL path is resolved from packages/db/, not project root
pitfalls.prevention: Use absolute paths or file: prefix with full path for SQLite databases
